name: imageharvest
description: Ordered website image collector for Windows
author: chinenar

scripts.test: node --test test/adaptive.test.cjs test/unit.test.cjs test/network-lookup.test.mjs test/protection-rules.test.cjs test/filter-stream.test.cjs test/manual-chrome-login.test.cjs test/ocr-review.test.cjs test/text-placement.test.cjs test/harvest-translate.test.cjs test/ocr-translation.test.cjs test/translation-performance.test.cjs test/ocr-speed.test.cjs test/ocr-content-role.test.cjs test/translation-overlay.test.cjs test/reader-stability.test.cjs test/reader-quality.test.cjs test/reader-priority.test.cjs
scripts.test:e2e: node test/e2e.cjs && node test/transient-preview.e2e.cjs && node test/browser-header-replay.e2e.cjs
scripts.test:adaptive: node --test test/adaptive.test.cjs && node test/adaptive-browser.e2e.cjs && node test/adaptive-production.e2e.cjs
scripts.test:ocr: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/ocr-review.test.cjs test/ocr-engine.test.cjs test/ocr-backend.test.cjs test/ocr-advanced.test.cjs test/text-placement.test.cjs test/ocr-speed.test.cjs test/ocr-content-role.test.cjs
scripts.test:overlay: node --test test/translation-overlay.test.cjs && node test/translation-overlay.e2e.cjs && node test/harvest-translation.e2e.cjs && node test/reader-stability.e2e.cjs
scripts.test:reader-stability: node --test test/reader-stability.test.cjs && node test/reader-stability.e2e.cjs && node test/reader-lock-cancel.e2e.cjs
